Deputy Pat the Cope Gallagher asked the Minister for Housing, Local Government and Heritage further to the review of the vacant property refurbishment grant carried out in 2024, if he has considered introducing phased payments of the grant in order to assist applicants with cash flow in managing such projects, particularly with massive increased costs in construction; if he has further considered that staged payments would make the scheme more manageable for those that struggle with construction costs and would make more houses available in time; and if he will make a statement on the matter. [41861/25]
